correctness.rationale: The labelled prism C_n square K2 has top, bottom and rung edges in n columns, and the third-edge EOP conflict is fully local to column offsets at most two. The independent transfer checker constructed conflicts directly from the n=11 graph, found exactly 37 admissible local mask triples and 17 consecutive-mask states. With potential φ=1 precisely at (0,5),(0,6),(1,5),(2,6), all transfer arcs have integer slack 1+φ(v)-φ(u)-popcount(next_mask) in {0,1}; exactly 24 tight arcs and 13 unit-slack arcs. Its independently built integer adjacency matrices A,B satisfy A^8=A^2, tr(A^n) for n=4..9 equals [0,0,6,0,0,0], and tr(A^(n-1)B) equals [2,4,6,2,2,4], hence repeat by six. The potential telescopes on all cyclic words so weight=n-number_of_unit_slack_arcs; zero-slack extrema only when 6|n (six words), otherwise exactly one slack gives n-1 edges and count n tr(A^(n-1)B). Direct independently built graph backtracking for n=3..7 matches the n=3 exceptional case (2,12) and subsequent formulas. The all-n theorem follows from exact transfer identity, not finite pattern interpolation.
residual_risks: For n=3 the graph has extra wraparound conflicts and is treated separately.
